violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. . Sanitizer in the sani-bucket was 0ppm when tested. Solution was switched out and retested at 150ppm.
Clean-in-place (CIP) equipment - Design and construction. — --Nonfood contact surface of clean in place equipment * was not cleaned properly. . Clean in place equipment dirty. (Fryer)

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)* were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. . Floors walls and ceiling throughout require a thorough cleaning.

Lighting. — --Existing light fixtures * did not provide adequate illumination. . Light under hood was unable to be turned on due to dripping water from ceiling or roof dripping dripping down and over bulb.
Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. Uncovered tortilla next to hand washing sink.
Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Company policy is to discard food after 2 hour holding. There is no stickers, logs to support that information.
Clean-in-place (CIP) equipment - Design and construction. — --Nonfood contact surface of clean in place equipment was not cleaned properly. Fans in walk in cooler had dust build up hanging down.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. Pepsi machine ice chute has black/green build up inside the chute.
Number, location, accessibility, soap and paper towels provided (3 pts deducted)
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
Clean, proper use, storage, sanitizing solution (2 pts deducted)
Designed, constructed, installed, and maintained (1 pt deducted)
